topic.title: Chat History Preferences
topic.shortdesc: Configure how the title and the description of each chat are generated in the chat history, and how long the chats are kept.

body.p: The Chat History preferences page is available in Options Preferences Plugins Oxygen AI Positron Chat History . It contains the following options:

dlentry.dt: Automatically generate chat title and description using AI

dd.p: When this option is selected (the default), the AI generates (in the background) the title and description used to identify a chat in the chat history. The AI generates them from the first message you send, in the same language as that message. A title contains no more than 50 characters.
For a chat that you start by running an action, the title and description are generated from the action and the content on which it was run.

Until the AI returns the title and description, the chat is listed using its first message. If this option is not selected, the first message is used as both the title and description. You can rename a chat at any time from the chat history.

dlentry.dd: Specifies the AI model used to generate titles and descriptions. This option is available only when the Automatically generate chat title and description using AI option is selected. The drop-down list contains models from all enabled connections, including AI Positron Service models when the service is enabled. If no model is selected, or if the selected model is no longer available, the model currently used by the chat is used.

dlentry.dt: Delete chats not changed for more than (days)
dlentry.dd:
When this option is selected (the default), conversations in the current project that were not changed for the specified number of days are deleted from the chat history. The default number of days is 365; you can specify a value from 1 through 9999. To keep conversations indefinitely, clear this option.
Deleted conversations are moved to the Recycle Bin or, on macOS, the Trash when the operating system supports it. Otherwise, they are deleted permanently. The number of days is counted from the date of the last change, in whole calendar days: only the day of the last change matters, not its time. For example, with a value of 30, a conversation last changed on September 19, at any hour, is kept through October 19 and can be deleted starting on October 20.Old conversations are deleted in the background when the application starts, when a project is opened, or when you change this option or its value and click OK or Apply. If the change would delete conversations, a confirmation dialog first reports how many will be deleted. If you click Cancel, no conversations are deleted at that time, but the new setting is retained and applied the next time the application starts or the project is opened. The same confirmation is shown when you open a project whose project options keep conversations for fewer days.
The number of days can be stored in project options so that everyone working on a project uses the same value. When you open a project that retains conversations for fewer days than the previous setting, you are asked to confirm the deletion before any conversations are removed.
